Model Evidence — roles, books and sleeve detail

Historical Performance — paper reconstruction (25 bps, PIT)

Methodology — how this decision is assembled
The decision headline, action buckets, agreement classes and health statuses are deterministic rules over stored fields (documented in api/portfolio_manager.py) — no language model, no invented expected returns, no manufactured confidence scores. Signals come from the validated Phase 25 platform (frozen fundamental panel + owned survivorship-free momentum panel); the executed-portfolio mark is the canonical Phase 14-C valuation. Data-readiness detail lives under Research & Audit.

Manual Review Flow MANUAL ONLY
  1. Refresh desk market data (manual, below).
  2. Review the proposed portfolio and health.
  3. Preview the paper-alpha snapshot (read-only).
  4. Confirm the snapshot manually (ledger-only write).
  5. Create, preview and confirm paper orders (desk below).
  6. Monitor paper fills, NAV and attribution.
